evidence.scope: 9 existing M-mode Clang/LLD/QEMU regressions plus 3 typed-machine/renderer tests

changes: backend::machine lowers checked CFG into Inst, preserving original validation, frame layout, ABI plans and arithmetic checks
backend::emit delegates through machine then assembly; one semantic lowering, no assembly parsing or backend subprocesses
backend::assembly renders all Inst variants, validates register/immediate/symbol forms and duplicate definitions, allows unresolved external targets
Branch and Jump render fixed AUIPC/JALR sequences through x31; all backend live temporaries t0..t5 preserved; generated relocation labels avoid source labels and references
Typed execution tests cover >4 KiB forward jump/backward conditional and Address relocation label collision
limitations: B tests use reference assembly/Clang/LLD plus QEMU M-mode; source-to-direct-ELF end-to-end evidence belongs to I
Reference Li remains an assembler pseudo instruction and need not use the same expansion as the direct encoder
Prototype retains previous Core S language subset, ABI and stack-slot strategy; no new language features or self-hosting
